selection_basis: The only training-derived revision passed the advisory screen on four training pairs: style improved, meaning and usefulness did not worsen on average, and there were no paired meaning regressions. This is preliminary evidence, not significance or human calibration.
remaining_evaluation: One validation run and one test run, four pairs each, with this same frozen candidate. No further spec or rubric edits in this series.
qualitative_examples: Present the three test cases with the longest upstream reference word counts, regardless of their outcomes. Full results for all cases remain available.
test_policy: Once exposed test results influence future choices, treat these cases as development data and obtain a new holdout.
